location: Port Fairy, South West Coast VIC
content_text:
- Permanent full-time - monthly RDO accrual available
- Based at the Koroit depot
Be Council’s lead technical voice on development engineering in one of south-west Victoria’s growing shires.
The successful applicant will assess and approve subdivision and development designs, set engineering permit conditions and negotiate outcomes with developers and consultants. They will also design and deliver Council’s own road, drainage and bridge projects.
To be successful in this role you will need
Qualifications and Experience
- Applicants MUST hold permanent citizenship or Visa with Permanent work rights in Australia - Sponsorship is not available and applications that do not meet this requirement will not be considered.
Essential qualifications and level of experience required to perform the job competently:
- Bachelor of Civil Engineering qualification and experience eligible for certification under the Victorian Professional Engineers Registration Act 2019
- Ability to procure, supervise, and project management infrastructure projects
- Road Drainage and Bridge design experience
Desirable:
- Qualifications in Project Management
Key selection criteria 1
Engineering and Local Government knowledge of road, footpath, drainage, bridge design and construction standards, Legislation and practices.
Key selection criteria 2
Communication skills with contractor representatives, government departments, consultants and all levels of in-house staff as required
Key selection criteria 3
Design and Project manage projects with skills to design and supervise infrastructure projects to relevant standards on time and within budget.
Applications that fail to address the above key selection criteria will not be considered for this position.
For more information 
For further information about the position or duties involved, please contact Anthony Bartlett, Engineering Coordinator on 0436 444 741 or anthony.bartlett@moyne.vic.gov.au
